meta.title: Carbon Ledger — annual CO2 emissions by country
meta.source: Our World in Data, CO2 and greenhouse gas emissions dataset, based on the Global Carbon Budget (Global Carbon Project)
meta.units: co2 in million tonnes (Mt); 1 Gt = 1,000 Mt
meta.scope: Territorial CO2 from fossil fuels and industry (coal, oil, gas, flaring, cement and other industrial processes). Excludes land-use change unless stated, and excludes other greenhouse gases. Each country carries its sector split (coal, oil, gas, cement, flaring, other industry) and net land-use-change CO2 for its latest year; blanks in the source sector columns are 0 in OWID's accounting (the six sectors sum to the fossil total).
meta.sectors: coal, oil, gas, cement, flaring, other industry (Mt) — the OWID sector split of the fossil total
meta.luc_note: land_use_change_co2 is NET only (positive = net source, negative = net sink); the dataset carries no gross sources-vs-sinks split.
